The name Herwig carries the meaning “Freeman, Army Leader” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, German, Latin. Parents who choose Herwig usually hope their child will grow to embody freeman, army leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
